purpose: One table that separates the Open Clank engine from a real MiMo Code install: no shared environment variable, folder, file, database, binary or project folder. Applied by apply.py, enforced by check_leftovers.py. Patterns are Python regular expressions.

names.environment: MIMOCODE_<X> and MIMO_<X> become OPENCLANK_<X>; no fallback to the old name
names.project_folder: .openclank (was .mimocode); project id file .openclank-project-id; project config openclank.json / openclank.jsonc
names.home_override: OPENCLANK_HOME (was MIMOCODE_HOME): data/, cache/, config/, state/ below it
names.xdg_fallback: openclank-engine under each XDG base directory (was mimocode); 'openclank' is not used because the Host already owns ~/.config/openclank
names.package_scope: @mimo-ai/* stays: internal workspace scope, never on the user's machine
